title: Optimal Treatment of Miscarriage
brief_summary: The main objective of the study is to determine if there is a difference in the number of women with a complete miscarriage after 10 days between expectant management versus treatment with 800 micrograms of misoprostol intravaginally in women with an an incomplete miscarriage before 14 weeks and a gestational sac retained in the uterus.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* nonviable intrauterine pregnancy with retained gestational sac in the uterus
* the embryo if visible 5 to 35 mm without a heart beat
* vaginal bleeding
* circulatory stable
* hemoglobin at least 80 g/L

Exclusion Criteria:

* contraindications against misoprostol
